Description: Gain a powerful random buff and a minor random debuff for the next battle.
Mechanics: Buff: +30% Dmg OR +30% Spd OR Invincibility(5s). Debuff: -10% Def OR -10% Acc OR Minor DoT.
Flavor Text: Where instinct leads, consequence follows.

Description: Enhance your next activated ability or consumable item use.
Mechanics: Next ability use: instant cooldown reset OR Next consumable: double effectiveness/duration.
Flavor Text: Will shapes the tools at hand.
Notes: Tactical choice required for maximum benefit.

Description: Reveals attack patterns or weaknesses of the next major enemy.
Mechanics: Reveals Boss/Elite primary pattern OR a specific elemental/physical weakness (+25% dmg taken).
Flavor Text: Secrets whisper to those who listen.

Description: Gain very minor health recovery upon killing enemies in the next battle.
Mechanics: On enemy kill: Recover 1 HP (Max 10 HP per battle).
Flavor Text: Life persists, even nourished by death.
column11: avoids breaking HP tension. Balance cap carefully.

Description: Gain resistance to knockback/stuns and minor damage reduction.
Mechanics: Resist Knockback/Stun effects. +10% Damage Reduction.
Flavor Text: Order imposes itself upon chaos.

Description: Reduces the cost of the next Blood Ritual performed.
Mechanics: Next Ritual: Health Cost reduced by 20% (relative) OR Item Cost reduced by 1 (if applicable).
Flavor Text: Ancient rites answer humbled pleas.
Notes: Synergizes directly with Blood Ritual system.

Description: Choose between a damage boost with speed penalty, or vice versa.
Mechanics: Choose: A) +25% Dmg, -10% Speed OR B) +25% Speed, -10% Dmg.
Flavor Text: Every path taken leaves another behind.

Description: Increases movement speed and rewards aggressive movement with damage.
Mechanics: +20% Move Speed. Dashing then damaging grants +10% Dmg briefly (3s cooldown).
Flavor Text: Victory belongs to the unwavering.

Description: Increases base damage and slightly increases poise/stagger resistance.
Mechanics: +15% Base Damage. Minor increase to Poise.
Flavor Text: True power comes from within, raw and untamed.

Description: Reveals the location of the next Blood Altar or a hidden item cache.
Mechanics: Reveals nearest Altar OR Hidden Cache on Overworld Map.
Flavor Text: Wisdom is found far from the beaten path.

Description: Next battle's rewards are significantly increased or decreased randomly.
Mechanics: 50% chance: +50% battle rewards (currency/items). 50% chance: -50% battle rewards.
Flavor Text: Fortune smiles or scowls as it wills.

Description: Triggers a damaging shockwave upon successful parry/block or taking low-health damage.
Mechanics: On Parry/Block OR on Hit taken below 30% HP: Minor AoE damage shockwave.
Flavor Text: Every action bears its own consequence.
Notes: Rewards defensive play or punishes mistakes.

Description: Immediately lose health, gain a permanent passive buff if you survive the next battle.
Mechanics: Immediate: Lose 15% Current HP. If survive next battle, gain permanent passive (e.g., +5% Max HP OR +3% Crit).
Flavor Text: Suspension brings revelation, often at a price.
column11: potentially high reward for skilled players.

Description: Unlocks a unique Ritual option or alters enemies in the next battle.
Mechanics: Unlocks unique Ritual option at next Altar OR Next Battle enemies: -25% HP, +15% Speed.
Flavor Text: Endings are merely beginnings in disguise.
Notes: Offers strategic choice or changes encounter dynamic.

Description: Increases positive status effect duration, decreases negative ones.
Mechanics: +20% Duration on own Buffs/DoTs applied. -20% Duration on Debuffs affecting player.
Flavor Text: Balance in all things; grace under pressure.
Notes: Subtle but strong with status effect builds.

Description: Gain a large permanent damage boost, but also take significantly more damage.
Mechanics: Permanent: +40% Damage Dealt, +20% Damage Taken. Cannot be removed.
Flavor Text: Power's chains are often forged by the wearer.

Description: Increases damage dealt and taken, adds random hazards to the next fight.
Mechanics: Next Battle: +25% Dmg Dealt, +25% Dmg Taken. Random environmental hazards spawn.
Flavor Text: Foundations crumble; the unforeseen strikes.

Description: Minor health recovery after battle if damaged, or guarantees a new Tarot card next draw.
Mechanics: If damaged in next battle, restore 5% dmg taken (max 5 HP) post-battle OR Next Tarot draw is unique this run.
Duration: End of Next Battle / Next Tarot Draw
Flavor Text: Even in darkness, a guiding light remains.
Notes: Minor relief or helps card pool diversity.

Description: Enemies have a chance to miss or attack illusions. Reduces enemy accuracy.
Mechanics: Next Battle: Enemies have 15% chance to miss/attack illusion. Minor Accuracy reduction.
Flavor Text: What is real, and what is feared?

Description: Major damage/speed boost for next battle, reveals current overworld map fully.
Mechanics: Next Battle: +25% Damage, +15% Attack Speed. Reveals current Overworld map secrets.
Flavor Text: Clarity burns away shadow; success illuminates the path.
Notes: Strong offensive boost with exploration utility.

Description: Gain bonus damage against the area boss or double resources from next battle.
Mechanics: Choice: +30% Damage vs Area Final Boss OR Next Battle: Enemies drop double resources.
Duration: Final Boss of Area / Next Battle
Flavor Text: The call echoes; accounts must be settled.
Notes: Strong effect tailored for specific situations.

Description: Grants an immediate major reward like meta-currency, items, or skipping a fight.
Mechanics: Choose: A) Gain Meta-Currency B) Gain 3 Random Items C) Skip next non-boss battle.
Flavor Text: Completion, integration, and the journey's reward.
